description: This file provides shared utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to colors, specifically for use with dark-themed dashboards. It includes functions for generating deterministically pastel-colored hues from strings and mapping common status indicators to theme colors.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel-friendly HSL color from a given string, producing distinct hues for different strings while maintaining saturation and lightness suitable for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a status string to a pre-defined theme color (such as primary, success, error) or generates a deterministic color if the status is unknown, to ensure consistent visual cues in dashboards.
